summary: Establish daily movement habit with easy aerobic cycling, one run, and a foundational strength session — no intensity, all about consistency and aerobic base activation.

sessions.name: Aerobic Foundation Spin
sessions.focus: Re-establish Z2 feel on the bike, aerobic base activation

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, cadence 85-90 rpm, HR settle below 140 bpm
Z2 steady aerobic, cadence 88-92 rpm, HR 146-162 bpm, conversational effort
Z1 wind down, cadence 80 rpm, HR below 140 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Steady Z2 Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Extended aerobic base, indoor alternative to run, Z2 steady effort

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, cadence 85-90 rpm, HR settle below 140 bpm
Z2 steady aerobic, cadence 88-92 rpm, HR 146-162 bpm, smooth and conversational — dial in a rhythm you can hold
Z1 wind down, cadence 80 rpm, HR below 140 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Active Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Flush Monday and Tuesday load, active recovery, stay below Z2

steps.description: Z1 very light spin, cadence 80-85 rpm
Z1 recovery ride, cadence 82-88 rpm, HR below 145 bpm throughout — blood flow only
Ease off completely, gentle spin, HR settling

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core Strength
sessions.focus: Leg and core strength foundation — shoulder protected throughout
sessions.notes: 2 rounds: 12x goblet squat 16kg (held at chest), 10x Romanian deadlift 16kg, 10x TRX split squat per leg (balance assist only — keep shoulder passive), 15x banded glute bridge (band above knees), 30s dead bug. 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. Drop to 11kg if form breaks on goblet squat or RDL.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and lateral, hip circles, 10x bodyweight squat, 10x bodyweight glute bridge
2 rounds: 12x goblet squat 16kg, 10x RDL 16kg, 10x TRX split squat/leg, 15x banded glute bridge, 30s dead bug. 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds.
Kneeling hip flexor stretch 30s/side, standing hamstring stretch, figure-4 glute stretch 30s/side

sessions.name: Aerobic Spin with Cadence Focus
sessions.focus: Aerobic base plus neuromuscular cadence drill, end-of-week activation

steps.description: Z2 cadence focus 90-95 rpm, HR 146-162 bpm — shift load to cardiovascular system
Z1 wind down, HR settle below 135 bpm

sessions.name: Longer Aerobic Endurance Ride
sessions.focus: Weekly long aerobic ride — extend Z2 duration, fat oxidation, aerobic ceiling

steps.description: Z1 gradual build, cadence 85-90 rpm, take time settling in
Z2 long aerobic block — start lower half 106-125W for first 20 min, allow natural drift to 130-141W if HR stays below 162 bpm. Cadence 88-92 rpm. Do not drift into Z3.
Z1 step-down, reduce power every 2 min, HR below 135 bpm before stopping

summary: Extend aerobic volume slightly, introduce first taste of Z3 tempo on the bike (short blocks only), progress strength to 3 rounds, keep run easy.

sessions.name: Steady Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Extended Z2, build aerobic duration from week 1

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 run, slightly extended duration

sessions.name: Active Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Z1 flush, keep easy

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core Strength — 3 Rounds
sessions.focus: Progress to 3 rounds, same movements, introduce single-leg load

sessions.name: Z3 Taste — Short Sweet Spot Blocks
sessions.focus: 3x5min at high Z2/low Z3 (135-155W) — first aerobic stress above base

sessions.name: Aerobic Long Ride
sessions.focus: Longest Z2 ride yet — extend to 50min main set

summary: Enter build phase — introduce proper sweet spot intervals (Z3 sustained blocks), extend Saturday ride to full 60 min at Z2, progress strength loading.

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Spin
sessions.focus: Z2 aerobic, higher cadence drill maintained

sessions.name: Easy Run with Strides
sessions.focus: Z2 run plus 4x20s light pickups at end — neuromuscular activation

sessions.name: Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Z1 active recovery

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Load Progression
sessions.focus: Increase dumbbell weight on goblet squat and RDL, 3 rounds

sessions.name: Sweet Spot Intervals — 3x8min
sessions.focus: Z3 sweet spot (142-165W), 3x8min — first real aerobic stress of the block

sessions.name: Long Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: 60 min Z2 — aerobic engine development at peak base volume

summary: Recovery week — cut volume ~40%, all sessions easy Z1-Z2, no intensity. Let adaptation from weeks 1-3 consolidate before next block begins.

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Z1 only, short — 20 min, flush legs

sessions.name: Easy Short Run
sessions.focus: Z1 conversational 20 min — movement only, no load

sessions.name: Light Maintenance Strength
sessions.focus: 2 rounds only, reduce load by 20%, maintain movement patterns

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: 40 min Z2 — maintain aerobic stimulus without accumulating fatigue
